card_reads.read: The board and our number agree in a maiden special weight at six furlongs on dirt. We make the top one 26% against the board's 26%.
card_reads.shape: Nobody is clearly entitled to the lead going six furlongs on dirt, which over a sprint usually means an honest pace rather than a meltdown, and a race run close to the figures. Only one has shown genuine early speed, and without company it may get away with a softer lead than the figures suggest. No pace adjustment applied.
